test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: When a laptop is sold at Rs. 55,000, a person earns a 25% gain. Find the cost price of the laptop.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Profit = 25% = 1/4 (Fractional value)

If **Cost Price (CP)** = 4 units, then **Selling Price (SP)** = 4 + 1 = 5 units.

Given: 5 units = Rs. 55,000

⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 11,000

⇒ 4 units (CP) = 4 × 11,000 = Rs. 44,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 44,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Selling Price (SP)** = Rs. 55,000

**Profit Percentage** = 25%

**Formula Used:**

**Cost Price (CP)** = [SP × 100] ÷ [100 + Profit %]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb70ac87423596ca2a44606d51d022b6a8cb799f26e28d8858b93ca16d2f8f0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ CP = [55,000 × 100] ÷ [100 + 25]

⇒ CP = [55,000 × 100] ÷ 125

⇒ CP = 55,000 × (4/5)

⇒ CP = 11,000 × 4

⇒ CP = Rs. 44,000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 44,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit and Loss Calculation

Profit = SP − CP and Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100. CP is always the base for profit/loss unless specified.

Marked Price and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price (MP)**. SP = MP × (100 − Discount %) ÷ 100.

Successive Profit/Loss

Effective percentage change for two successive changes x and y is given by [x + y + (xy/100)]%.</p
